snippet.title: Fortune Seller | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
🔮💫 Fortune Seller is OUT NOW on Steam & Epic! 💫🔮
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3874000/Fortune_Seller/
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/fortune-seller-218103

A gothic roguelike shopkeeping game where you sell antiques, read the tarot, and manage your inventory to survive crushing rent increases. Match strange customers with the relics they crave, unlock powerful cards, and gamble your way out of debt, one deal at a time.

🔹 Hands-on Inventory Management
🔹 Read your customers, match their tastes, and score huge payouts.
🔹 Tarot-Based Upgrades. Draw cards between days to gain powerful new abilities.
🔹 Spiral into debt. Weekly rent hikes keep the pressure high.
🔹 Rebuild crumbling villages and earn the trust of the people
🔹 Roguelike Replayability

🎮 Now available on Steam & Epic for €6.99* (With a 10% launch discount).

Press inquiries: contact@kiwickstudios.com
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/asSmUHU3vH

#FortuneSeller #IndieGameLaunch #BuyNow #WishlistNow #StoryDrivenGames #SteamRelease #epicgames #GameDev #IndieDev
